changelog:
BobLimt v1.0.7

- Added the new Update window with changelog notes and an Update Now button.
- Kept full-folder updates so new files are installed automatically while preserving BobLimt.cfg and Ahk.
- Refreshed overlay styling, transparency, timer sizing, and MM:SS timer display.
- Improved raid/dungeon clear notification timing and quick refresh after 30k ends.
- Improved swap loadout opening reliability and AHK SendInput hotkey detection.
- Reverted the app window resizing experiment so controls use the original window sizing.
